As a C language expert, convert C code constraints to Z3 solver script.

        Input constraints: ['!(!(track->par->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO && !track->audio_vbr)) || !(track->entry) || !(!stts_entries)', '!(track->par->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO && !track->audio_vbr) || !(!stts_entries)']
        Relevant conditions/variables: [], stts_entries

        Guidelines:
        1. Convert only constraints affecting the specified conditions/variables

```python
from z3 import *

# Declare variables
# track->par->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO  -> boolean flag
codec_type_is_audio = Bool('codec_type_is_audio')
# !track->audio_vbr  -> boolean flag (audio_vbr is false)
audio_vbr_is_false = Bool('audio_vbr_is_false')
# track->entry  -> boolean flag (entry is non-null / truthy)
track_entry = Bool('track_entry')
# stts_entries  -> boolean flag (stts_entries is non-null / truthy)
stts_entries = Bool('stts_entries')

# Constraint 1:
# !(!(track->par->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO && !track->audio_vbr)) || !(track->entry) || !(!stts_entries)
# Simplify: (codec_type_is_audio && audio_vbr_is_false) || !track_entry || stts_entries
# Included because it references stts_entries (and the other relevant conditions).
constraint1 = Or(
    And(codec_type_is_audio, audio_vbr_is_false),
    Not(track_entry),
    stts_entries
)

# Constraint 2:
# !(track->par->codec_type == AVMEDIA_TYPE_AUDIO && !track->audio_vbr) || !(!stts_entries)
# Simplify: !(codec_type_is_audio && audio_vbr_is_false) || stts_entries
# Included because it directly constrains stts_entries.
constraint2 = Or(
    Not(And(codec_type_is_audio, audio_vbr_is_false)),
    stts_entries
)

# Solve
s = Solver()
s.add(constraint1)
s.add(constraint2)

print(s.check())
if s.check() == sat:
    print(s.model())
```
